function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure thing! Here’s a quick guide on where you can order a cake, plus a few tips to help you pick the best option for your needs.

---

## 1. Local Bakeries (Best for Freshness & Customization)

| What to Look For | Why It Matters | How to Order |
|------------------|----------------|--------------|
| **In‑person or online ordering** | Many local shops let you see the cake in person or view a photo gallery online. | Call, visit their website, or use their app. |
| **Custom designs** | You can request specific flavors, decorations, or dietary accommodations (gluten‑free, vegan, etc.). | Provide a design brief or sketch; most bakeries will give you a quote. |
| **Same‑day delivery** | Some offer same‑day pickup or delivery within a certain radius. | Ask about delivery windows and any extra fees. |

**How to find them:**
- Google “cake shop near me” or “custom cake bakery in [your city]”.
- Check Yelp or TripAdvisor for reviews and photos.
- Ask friends or coworkers for recommendations.

---

## 2. National & Online Cake Delivery Services

| Service | Highlights | Typical Delivery Area |
|---------|------------|-----------------------|
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection from top U.S. bakeries; great for special occasions. | Nationwide (delivery times vary by region). |
| **Cake Delivery** | Same‑day delivery in many U.S. cities; offers a wide range of flavors. | Major U.S. cities (check their website for coverage). |
| **Baker’s Dozen** | Focus on artisanal, small‑batch cakes; often vegan or gluten‑free options. | Nationwide (delivery times vary). |
| **Etsy** | Handmade cakes from independent bakers worldwide. | Worldwide (delivery depends on seller). |

**Tips:**
- Order at least 1–2 weeks in advance for custom cakes.
- Read shipping policies—some services ship refrigerated or with a “keep‑cold” kit.
- Check cancellation policies in case plans change.

---

## 3. Grocery Stores & Supermarkets

| Store | What They Offer | When to Use |
|-------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Whole Foods** | Freshly baked cakes, often with organic ingredients. | Quick pick‑up or same‑day delivery via Amazon Fresh. |
| **Trader Joe’s** | Seasonal cakes (e.g., pumpkin, chocolate). | Great for last‑minute orders; no customization. |
| **Kroger / Safeway** | In‑store bakeries with a variety of flavors. | Convenient for local pickup or curbside. |
| **Walmart** | Affordable cakes, often with a “ready‑to‑serve” option. | Good for budget‑friendly events. |

**How to order:**
- Visit the store’s website or app for online ordering and delivery options.
- Many supermarkets partner with delivery services like Instacart or Shipt.

---

## 4. Food‑Delivery Apps (Convenient for Quick Orders)

| App | What to Search | Pros |
|-----|----------------|------|
| **Uber Eats** | “Cake” or “Bakery” | Same‑day delivery, real‑time tracking. |
| **DoorDash** | “Cake” or “Dessert” | Often includes local bakeries and chain stores. |
| **Postmates** | “Cake” | Good for last‑minute orders in urban areas. |
| **Grubhub** | “Cake” | Wide selection of local restaurants and bakeries. |

**Pro Tip:** Some apps allow you to filter by “specialty” or “custom orders,” so you can find bakeries that accept custom requests.

---

## 5. Specialty & Dietary‑Focused Options

| Category | Example Services | Why Choose Them |
|----------|------------------|-----------------|
| **Vegan & Gluten‑Free** | **Vegan Cake Co.**, **Gluten‑Free Bakery** | Perfect for guests with dietary restrictions. |
| **Low‑Sugar / Keto** | **Sugarless Bakery**, **Keto Cakes** | Great for health‑conscious celebrations. |
| **Allergy‑Friendly** | **Allergy‑Aware Bakery** | Offers allergen‑free options (nuts, dairy, soy). |

---

## Quick Checklist Before You Order

1. **Event Date** – Order early (especially for custom cakes).
2. **Flavor & Size** – Confirm the cake size (e.g., 8‑inch, 12‑inch) and flavor.
3. **Decoration** – Provide a photo or description of the desired design.
4. **Dietary Needs** – Specify any allergies or dietary restrictions.
5. **Delivery Time** – Confirm the exact delivery window and any special instructions (e.g., “leave at front door”).
6. **Payment & Cancellation** – Know the payment method and cancellation policy.

---

### Need a Specific Recommendation?

If you tell me your city or zip code, I can pull up a list of highly rated local bakeries or online services that deliver to your area. Just let me know!
